text.A: **Ova politika se primjenjuje gdje god se nalazili.** Pridržavamo se propisa Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva o zaštiti podataka, a kada se primjenjuju i propisi o zaštiti podataka države u kojoj živite, pridržavamo se i njih.
text.B: **Napomene o alergijama i prehrani.** Prosljeđujemo ih food trucku zajedno s vašom narudžbom i ne koristimo ih ni za šta drugo. Uklanjamo ih, zajedno s vašim imenom i kontakt podacima, 12 mjeseci nakon narudžbe (pogledajte odjeljak 7).
text.C: **Međunarodni prenosi.** Podaci vašeg računa i podaci o narudžbama čuvaju se i obrađuju u Ujedinjenom Kraljevstvu. Neke stvari se obrađuju izvan njega: izdvajanje menija i automatski odgovori na WhatsAppu, koji koriste Googleovu uslugu u Sjedinjenim Američkim Državama; dostava WhatsApp poruka, kojom upravlja Meta u Sjedinjenim Američkim Državama; plaćanja, kojima upravlja Stripe u Sjedinjenim Američkim Državama; i push obavještenja, koja dostavljaju Apple i Google u Sjedinjenim Američkim Državama. Kada podaci napuste Ujedinjeno Kraljevstvo, prenos je obuhvaćen britanskim propisima o adekvatnosti (UK adequacy regulations) ili Međunarodnim sporazumom o prenosu podataka (International Data Transfer Agreement) ili Dodatkom (Addendum), a kada to zahtijeva pravo vaše države, i zaštitnom mjerom koju to pravo priznaje. Možete nas pitati za pojedinosti o zaštitnim mjerama koje se primjenjuju.
text.G:
Naši [Uslovi korištenja](/terms) primjenjuju se u svakoj državi u kojoj se HatchGrab koristi. U nekim državama vrijede dodatna pravila. Ova stranica ih navodi, državu po državu.

Kada se neki od odjeljaka u nastavku odnosi na vas, on je sastavni dio naših Uslova korištenja. Ako navodi nešto drugačije od njih, za tu državu vrijedi ova stranica.

Ako vaša država nije navedena, nema dodatnih pravila: Uslovi korištenja primjenjuju se onako kako su napisani. Naša [Politika privatnosti](/privacy) ista je u svakoj državi.

back.A: **This policy applies wherever you may be.** We comply with UK data protection regulations, and when the data protection regulations of the country you live in also apply, we comply with those too.
back.B: **Notes on allergies and diet.** We forward them to the food truck together with your order and do not use them for anything else. We remove them, together with your name and contact details, 12 months after the order (see section 7).
back.C: ...or by the Addendum (Addendum), and when the law of your country requires it, also by a safeguard that this law recognises.
back.D: Intro: Under UK data protection regulations and the law of the country you live in, when it applies, you have the right to: [bullets unchanged]. / The law of the country you live in may give you these rights under other names or give you additional rights. You have those rights too. / **Submitting a request.** Write to privacy@hatchgrab.com. Before we act, we will check whether the request is genuine. You can ask someone to submit the request instead of you, and we will not treat you differently because of submitting a request. We will reply within one month or earlier if the law of your country requires it. If you ordered from a food truck, we may forward your request to that food truck, because it decides how your order details are used. If we refuse a request, you can ask us to reconsider it by replying to our answer. / **Deleting the account.** [unchanged] + When an operator's account is deleted, we also remove its customers' names, contact details and notes from the orders we keep. / **Marketing emails.** We send marketing emails only when the law of the country you live in allows it, which in some countries means only with your consent. Each one states who it is from, contains our postal address and states how to stop receiving them. If you ask us to stop, we will stop, free of charge and within 10 working days. Emails about an order or your account are not marketing. If we or a food truck offer order updates by SMS, you will receive them only if you agree to it, and you can stop them at any time. / **If something goes wrong.** If a breach involving your personal data is likely to cause you serious harm, we will inform you and the supervisory authority as soon as we can when the law requires it, or we will help the food truck you ordered from to do so. / **Complaints.** First contact us at privacy@hatchgrab.com; we would be grateful for the chance to put things right. You can also submit a complaint to the data protection authority in the country you live in. In the UK, that is the Information Commissioner's Office (Office of the Information Commissioner), at ico.org.uk or on 0303 123 1113.
back.G: Our [Terms of Use] apply in every country where HatchGrab is used. In some countries additional rules apply. This page sets them out, country by country. / When one of the sections below applies to you, it forms part of our Terms of Use. If it says something different from them, this page applies for that country. / If your country is not listed, there are no additional rules: the Terms of Use apply as written. Our [Privacy Policy] is the same in every country.
